card.line: Gibeon was a great hill city of the Hivites that tricked Israel into a peace treaty, and later saw a famous battle and Solomon's dream.

moments.title: The Gibeonites' trick
moments.text: Having heard what Joshua did to Jericho and Ai, the people of Gibeon dressed in worn clothes and carried moldy bread. They said they came from far away and asked for a treaty. Israel made peace with them without seeking the counsel of the LORD.

moments.title: Five kings attack Gibeon
moments.text: Gibeon was a great city, and five Amorite kings camped against it because it had made peace with Israel. The men of Gibeon sent word to Joshua to come quickly and save them.

moments.title: The sun stands still
moments.text: The LORD threw the enemy into confusion, and Israel defeated them at Gibeon. Joshua asked the sun to stand still over Gibeon, and it stopped for about a full day because the LORD fought for Israel.

moments.title: Battle by the pool
moments.text: Abner's men and Joab's men met on opposite sides of the pool of Gibeon. Twelve men from each side fought, and they all fell together. The place was called Helkath-hazzurim.

moments.title: Solomon's dream
moments.text: Solomon went to Gibeon, the great high place, and offered a thousand burnt offerings. That night the LORD appeared to him in a dream and said, "Ask, and I will give it to you!"
